item.title: slob life nu dada
item.description:
The entirely unanticipated EP by love sella. 44.1 KHz compositions for cyberwitches/-bitches. Kill all money: Your virtue is predispositioned.

item.title: Up in Flames
item.description:

item.title: Pieces of Peace
item.description:
17 pieces of peace written between the chaotic ages of 14-19.

One day my sibling called me up while I was pondering, lying on my brand new mattress after I’d just moved out. Saying: “Hey chef, remember those songs we recorded?” And of course I did, that’s what had been on my mind. That’s what I was lying there for.

Credits

  • Songwriting, lyrics, artwork and iPhone recording engineering by Jørgen Valdemar.
  • Production and engineering by Puk Bruinsma.
  • Visual design by Jan de Rooij.
  • Additional artwork by Inne Bruinsma.
  • Cello on the track “Three words” by Jordan van der Maas.
  • Photography by Wike Bruinsma.

Special thanks to

  • Mare and Rian — for being great bandmates in my little ghost.
  • Teun — for giving me my first recording experience and being a great friend.
  • Auktje — for telling me I should quit her piano lessons to pursue music creatively.
  • Joep and Jornt — for listening to my music and giving great feedback.
  • Jan — for all the patience in making the artwork together.
  • Puk — I couldn’t have made this album without you, thanks for the tea.
  • Samira — for giving me a feel for rhythm.
  • Eric Luth — for introducing me to the wonderful world of music.
  • Carla de Bruine — for listening to my songs and working on my vocals together.
  • Lieke.

item.title: Wacko_
item.description:
Wacko_ follows a narrative of “weirdifaction” —a bright sonic world that gradually unveils a creeping sense of absurdity. The album is the first album written, and recorded, by Cage.log. It is an IndieTronica/Art-pop album that blends Jazz, Funk, IDM, and Ambient influences.

Credits

  • Written by Cage.Log.
  • Recorded by Cage.Log.
  • Conceptualised by Dylan Hokstam.
  • Electric bass played by Cage.log.
  • Drum Tracks bitten through by Cage.log.
  • Electronic elements produced by CDL.
  • Lyrics by Cage.log.
  • Vocals by Dylan Hokstam.
  • Repetitively mixed by CDL.
  • Mastered by Robin van Ulft
  • Album cover painted by Dylan Hokstam.

Special thanks to

  • Robin van Ulft — for helping with mastering the Album.
  • Damian Been.
  • Puk Bruinsma.
  • Sytse Jan Vledder.
  • Elza Thio.
  • Everyone at Mlem Records — for helping with mixing, mastering and genuine interest.

item.title: Denken Aan Een Ander Is Niet Van Deze Tijd
item.description:
NL
Hoe ga je om met de verschrikkelijke tragedie dat het leven van een geprivilegieerd persoon in de 21e eeuw is? Hoe blijf je jezelf in een wereld die steeds groter en enger wordt? Dat vraagt Ulf Ten Aar zich al een tijdlang af.

In diens album “Denken Aan Een Ander Is Niet Van Deze Tijd” is die met beeldende, maatschappijkritische woorden en een stapel zelfspot een stuk dichterbij het antwoord gekomen.

item.title: indigo chamber
item.description:
on the debut ep of indigo chamber, a tension reigns between the urge for escapism and pressing wake-up calls from the real world, which seems to grow more imminent and frightening every day.

finding their retreat in hooky, hypnotic dreampop, the crystalline organs, oceanic synths, waltzy drum machines and languid falsetto vocals don’t seem to disturb the idyllic daydream.

but from under the perfect surface a threat of increasing frustration and dissatisfaction looms, and the ever so safe glass bubble is slowly starting to crack…

item.title: The Alan Watts Theme (love sella Remix)
item.description:
It all started when fellow the Hagueians Barend of the legendary trip hop duo AlmabuenA and local underground music legend WivWav got stuck in traffic together. After discussing their musical faves they birthed the conceptual remix exchange that would eventually grow into the legendary chopped and rearranged remix twins, the half of which is this release.

love sella is a legendary renoise producer and cyberwitch/-bitch. Creating dense and energtic electronic punk music for the crazed.

item.title: All my best friends don’t pass the turing test (AlmabuenA Remix)
item.description:
It all started when fellow the Hagueians Barend of the legendary trip hop duo AlmabuenA and local underground music legend WivWav got stuck in traffic together. After discussing their musical faves they birthed the conceptual remix exchange that would eventually grow into the legendary chopped and rearranged remix twins, the half of which is this release.

AlmabuenA is a fresh trip hop duo from Spain and The Netherlands. Made up of legendary studio master Barend and masterful club beat juggler Almudena. They’ve been f&%$ing up the scene these days, fast tracking remixes left and right. We couldn’t be happier to be a part of it.
